tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/async-runtime.md <<'EOF'
# Async runtime

No decision on the async runtime is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, this policy does not name a runtime.
EOF
cat docs/policies/async-runtime.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says that no async runtime decision is currently recorded, and it names no runtime.

Muninn has no decision or standing rule on the async runtime. It has only two trust-1 episodes, which are records of what was said, not decisions:
- **#13:** "async-std runtime".
- **#14:** "tokio, ecosystem is bigger", recorded a few seconds after #13.

Neither episode is marked as replacing the other, and `muninn why` returned "insufficient: no record of trust 2 or more". I chose not to treat the newer tokio episode as the current decision, so the file leaves the runtime unnamed.

If tokio is the intended choice, tell me and I'll update the paragraph. Recording it as a decision would also fix this in Muninn.

Separately, Muninn's heartbeat reported RED: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it.
